heroHeadline: CNN Barred From Air Force One as Trump Administration Escalates Press Restrictions and Moves to Reshape 2026 Midterm Rules
heroSubtitle: CNN was excluded from the Air Force One press pool for President Trump's upcoming trip on September 26, 2026, escalating the White House's media access crackdown that began with CNN, MSNBC, and Politico reporters being denied White House access in September 2026. Separately, a Le Monde analysis found the administration is pursuing efforts to reshape electoral rules ahead of the November 2026 midterms, including initiatives on voter registration and election administration that critics say are designed to benefit Republican candidates.
